title.fr: Ado Avatar — Cour des reflets cobalt
title.en: Ado Avatar — Courtyard of Cobalt Reflections

entries.incarnation: Avatar scénique fictif interne proposé, adaptation visuelle du sprite ado_avatar exact à bfd17af2; aucune identité ou personne réelle.

poseBrief.fr: Debout de trois quarts sur un pont bas, chaussure gauche sur une marche et droite sur le pavage inférieur; main gauche posée sur la rampe, main droite ouverte le long de la cuisse, tête légèrement tournée vers le spectateur.
poseBrief.en: Quiet three-quarter stance on a low bridge, left shoe on a step and right shoe on lower paving; left hand resting on the railing, right hand relaxed beside the thigh, head slightly turned toward the viewer.

background.location: Original backstage water courtyard within an imagined shadow-pop theatre complex.
background.foreground: Wet dark stone paving with cobalt reflections and clear space around both whole shoes.
background.midground: The single internal avatar on a low curved bridge above a shallow reflecting canal.
background.background: Empty rounded obsidian colonnade, night sky and slanted blue skylight; no audience or real-world stage.
background.lighting: Cobalt rim light, deep plum shadows and soft reflected light on the stylized face.

notes: Whole fictional anime avatar, all hair/coat tips and both shoes are inside frame with visible breathing room. Source blue bow, pale folded blouse, long open navy coat, straight dark trousers and long blue-black fringe hair retained. Anatomical LEFT hand on railing and LEFT shoe on raised step, RIGHT hand relaxed and RIGHT shoe on lower paving. No real face inferred, other character, text, logo, UI, weapon, microphone, instrument or added power. Original empty courtyard architecture differs from all three Ado CG03s. Eight observable axes checked individually above.
limitations: This is explicitly an adaptation visuelle du sprite interne; no absolute external likeness or official Ado fidelity is certified.
The historical sprite was a generated project interpretation with no documented real-person incarnation. The proposed fictional stage avatar does not resolve Ado’s real appearance.
Fine eye, blouse, shoe and coat construction at high resolution are interpretation from small pixel source details, not externally verified canon.
This approval applies only to ado_avatar; it does not qualify near-duplicate Uta Echo or Rebellion Dancer collateral sprites as distinct original identities.
